page.about: Each build features expertly chosen components we've tested and trusted, no guesswork, no compromises. With four models to choose from, the Ironside Series is your shortcut to powerful, stress-free gaming. Our signature line ships in just 2 business days, blending solid performance and upgrade-ready flexibility.

content.title: Performance that Ships in 2 Business Days.
content.description: Ready to go before you press order.

content.title: A New Design.
content.description: The thoughtfully redesigned Ironside Series features a colorful retro-futuristic flair, while still being subtle enough to blend seamlessly into any setup. With excellent airflow and expansion options, we've created a line that not only feels robust out of box, but also provides the flexibility for future upgrades.

content.title: Power Takes Precedence.
content.description: Choosing the right components for your system can be daunting, and we wanted to remove some of the challenge by creating a lineup that featured perfectly balanced, high quality hardware right out of the box. Through years of trial we've learned what works, what lasts, and what we trust putting our name behind.

content.title: A PC with Peace of Mind.
content.description: Our signature line of PCs is designed to remove the stress and let you get straight to the thing you love most: gaming. From the quality of your components to the longevity of your PC, you can be confident that you're receiving top-notch value along with the most accommodating support in the industry.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
